text: The paper reports that, estimating the belief in the correct answer as the mean accuracy of the five agents at each round, the trajectories across debate rounds are essentially flat on each benchmark, consistent with a martingale.
title: Mean agent accuracy stays flat across debate rounds, as the martingale predicts
